To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
there are problems existing in physical education materials and methods adopted for middle schools in China, which are mainly the following aspects: 1.

the current physical education teaching materials in middle schools have the following problems:(1) the contents of teaching materials are not in conformity to the physical education curriculum standard;(2) the contents of physical exercise are repeated and the contents are not systematic; (3) the contents of sports events are not systematic and the teaching materials are not scientific; (4) the teaching materials are too simple and the teaching methods are too traditional.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the physical education teaching materials in middle school, which is the basis of physical education teaching.

the following aspects: (1) to reexamine subject orientation and contents system of physical education and health teaching materials in the light of physical education and physical health curriculum standard; (2) to reexamination the contents of physical and health education teaching materials; (3) to reexamin the teaching methods of physical education and heath education; (4) to reexamen the teaching materials and methods of physical education science.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the physical education teaching materials adopted in middle schools are not in conformity to the physical education curriculum standard,and that the methods are not in conformity the physical education curriculum and the physical education teaching standard.

the problems with the contents and methods adopted in physical education teaching and the countermeasures are as follows:(1)The contents and methods of physical education teaching in middle schools are in conformity with the curriculum standard and are suitable for the physical education and health education of middle school students. (2)Physical education teaching contents and methods adopted should be in accordance with the characteristics of middle school students,which means they should be scientific and reasonable and should be in line with the physical and physiological development of students and
the contents of physical teaching materials and methods are too much and not enough, and that the contents are not in conformity to the physical education(and Health) curriculum standard.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the contents of physical teaching materials and methods are too many,and the contents are repeated and not in conformity with physical education(and health).The author proposed that the contents should be reexamined and the physical education teaching materials system be reformed.

the contents of physical teaching materials and methods should be based on the curriculum standard and the contents of physical and health education in middle schools should be divided into 2 parts,that is,general contents and individual sports events contents.
the physical education teaching materials should be designed on the basis of the physical education curriculum standard,and the teaching methods should be designed on basis of the teaching materials.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we should take the development of physical education teaching methods as the main line, and take the physical education teaching materials as the auxiliary.
the physical education curriculum should be based on the physical and mental development of middle school students and should be in conformity with the characteristics of physical education.
physical education teaching materials should be designed according to the characteristics of physical education and the physical development and health of middle school students.
